subject: general
question: Which state in India celebrates the 'Sundareswara Festival'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sree Sundareswara Temple is one of the two prominent temples consecrated by Sree Narayana Guru Devan in Kannur District, the other being Sree Jagannaatha Temple, Thalassery.
 
• On** April 11, 1916, Sree Narayana Guru,** a prominent social reformer, consecrated the **idol of Lord Shiva here**. This temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, is** one of the four temples** in the Kannur district that the Guru consecrated.** Sundareswara, **a manifestation of Lord Shiva, is worshipped here.
 
• The **temple's yearly celebration lasts eight days** and is held in the** Malayalam month of Meenam** (March - April).
 
• **The Arattu (Holy Bath)** ceremony is performed on the last day of the celebration, which is followed by a procession of **caparisoned elephants and fireworks. **The holiday is brightened by a variety of** religious and cultural events.**
 
• The temple is open to everyone, regardless of caste or creed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the country,** Kerala and Pondicherry** have the** highest female to male ratio** with Kerala taking the lead.
